admission.justification: Publication/rollback, complete proof protection and state-qualified retry are distinct obligations. Together they preserve a usable retirement identity and safe recovery; none alone guarantees both resolvability and completion of an interrupted irreversible cleanup.

guarantee: Master retirement preserves one protected proof and a resolvable sprint across publication; pre-archive failure restores sources and folder, an interrupted sprint edit is repaired by the identical request, and post-archive cleanup failure keeps retirement so the same request refreshes a stale projection and finishes only what remains without recreating deleted artifacts.
title: A master retirement is one recoverable operation
